description: This file is a shell script used for configuring GRE tunnels, network interfaces, and system events related to a hotspot device, primarily for network setup and management.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes snooper system events by enabling circuit and remote snooping.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from the PSM database and external files for setting up network parameters.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates a GRE tunnel and configures network interfaces for hotspot communication.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Sets system events related to keepalive functionality for the hotspot.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Configures iptables rules for forwarding and filtering network traffic.
